Senior Backend Engineer — Tel Aviv (hybrid)

We're a fast-growing fintech infrastructure company processing millions of transactions daily. We're looking for a backend engineer to join our core platform team in Tel Aviv.

What you'll do:
- Design and build high-throughput backend services in Python
- Own services in production: deployment, monitoring, incident response
- Work with our event streaming platform (Kafka) to build reliable data pipelines
- Operate workloads on Kubernetes: deployments, autoscaling, troubleshooting
- Model and optimize data in PostgreSQL
- Build on AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda)

What we're looking for:
- 2+ years of backend development experience in Python or Go
- Production experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization
- Hands-on Kafka experience: consumers, producers, exactly-once semantics
- Kubernetes experience is required — Helm, HPA, debugging pods in production
- AWS experience strongly preferred
- Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
- B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to have:
- Terraform, ArgoCD, gRPC
- Experience in fintech or other regulated environments
